title: Dalton AI Development Lab
description: Planning a local and hybrid AI development environment to support software engineering, autonomous development agents, task management, and workflow automation.

title: AI Development Dashboard
description: Exploring a centralized development dashboard for monitoring AI agents, managing project tasks, coordinating automated workflows, and overseeing development infrastructure remotely.

title: Social Farming Simulation
description: Conceptualizing a modern social farming game inspired by the original Facebook FarmVille experience, preserving its accessible crop-growing, livestock, farm expansion, and neighbor interactions while exploring deeper progression, expanded customization, and new multiplayer features.
note: An original game concept with no affiliation with Zynga or FarmVille rights holders. These are possibilities, not implementation commitments.
notes: Earning in-game currency and expanding farmland

title: Fantasy MMORPG
description: Exploring the design of a persistent multiplayer fantasy world featuring character progression, cooperative gameplay, multiple realms, and scalable online infrastructure.
note: A long-term concept; no operational game or multiplayer server is claimed.

title: Multiplayer Action Game
description: Exploring competitive multiplayer game development with an emphasis on responsive gameplay, networking, matchmaking, dedicated servers, and scalable online systems.
